name: ReXGlue Xbox 360 (separate SDK and local profile overlay)
license: BSD-3-Clause; dependencies retain their own notices
notes: SDK 0.10.0 installed separately. Three unmodified source files needed for per-project profile overlays are shipped with original notices and hashes in app/xbox_support/third_party/rexglue. No game content or SDK binaries are shipped.

name: SMAA reference sources and lookup tables
notes: License and pinned source metadata are preserved in app/xbox_support/third_party/smaa. Used by the optional separately built native GPU plugin.

name: AnyPS5 (optional separate executable and compatibility libraries)
license: GPL-2.0-only; see upstream for included dependencies
notes: Official releases remain a separate optional engine with published SHA256 verification. The experimental depth-copy, shader-preparation, persistent snapshot-slice, ABI investigation and native graphics source patches in engine-patches are GPL-2.0-only, with their license, pinned upstream commit and file hashes preserved there; their build script produces separate compatibility libraries. Engine code is not imported into the Python runtime. Installed engines and their dependencies retain their upstream licenses.

name: PS5 UltraPack (optional separate extraction backend)
license: MIT source; bundled backend dependencies have their own licenses
notes: Official source is installed at a resolved Git commit with a private Python environment and optional separately built .NET package helper. The distributed upstream application has additional license terms; preserve the checkout's notices, including its vendored components. No backend source is vendored in this Tool.

name: CyUI
notes: Selected unmodified Python Core and optional modules, pinned to ff023e646c6a3038b3dfbfd53f6d2b4a2f5955e3. The source repository currently requires GitHub access. The MIT notice is included in app/vendor/CYUI_LICENSE.txt. Per-file SHA256 and dependency selection: app/vendor/cyui-source.json. Existing imgui-bundle supplies the single ImGui instance and retained native source-editor binding.

name: Electron (downloaded on demand)
notes: Official platform archives are installed privately under runtime/engines/electron with a published SHA256. Not redistributed with CyDecompilator; bundled runtime license files remain in its installation.

name: TypeScript parser (downloaded on demand)
notes: Version 5.9.3 downloaded privately from the official npm registry and verified against dist.integrity SHA512. Node.js on PATH is caller installed; inspected modules are never required or executed.

name: NetCoreDbg (downloaded on demand)
notes: Installed from official Samsung GitHub releases under runtime/engines/netcoredbg with the published SHA256 when available. Runs as an isolated Debug Adapter Protocol process; not redistributed with CyDecompilator.

name: Ghidra (downloaded on demand)
notes: Downloaded from the official GitHub release into runtime/engines/ghidra with its published SHA256. Not redistributed with CyDecompilator.

name: Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 (downloaded on demand, or the system Java)
notes: Downloaded from the Adoptium API with its published SHA256 when no Java 21+ JDK is installed.

name: ILSpy / ilspycmd and ICSharpCode.Decompiler (downloaded on demand)
notes: Downloaded from nuget.org.

name: dnlib 4.5.0 (managed method patcher, restored on demand)
notes: Restored from official NuGet in locked mode, with the published SHA512 in app/managed/packages.lock.json. Built and cached under runtime/engines/managed-patcher; not installed into the Tool Python runtime.

name: Roslyn C# editor services (from the installed .NET SDK)
notes: Uses the compiler/workspace/features assemblies bundled with the local SDK dotnet-format. No NuGet package or analyzer is downloaded; the helper and SDK assemblies are cached under runtime/engines/csharp-services.

name: .NET runtime (downloaded on demand, or the system runtime)
notes: Downloaded from Microsoft's release metadata and checked against its published SHA512.

name: Vineflower (downloaded on demand)
notes: Downloaded from the official GitHub release with its published SHA256.

name: JADX (downloaded on demand)
notes: Downloaded from the official GitHub release with its published SHA256.

name: xdis, uncompyle6, decompyle3 (downloaded on demand)
notes: Installed from PyPI with pip into runtime/engines/pydecompile and run in a separate process.

name: Capstone, pefile, pyelftools (built-in native engine)
notes: Python packages of the private runtime.

name: CyDecompilator shader engine (DXBC, SPIR-V, DXIL)
notes: Written for CyDecompilator from the public Direct3D token format and the Khronos SPIR-V specification. No third-party decompiler code.

name: AI providers and cyai_connectors (from CyTools_AIChat)
license: Same author; cyai_connectors declares no licence
notes: Agent command lines (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode) are not redistributed: the programs already installed and signed in on this machine are started, under their publishers' terms. HTTP providers are reached with the user's own API key.

name: Dear ImGui / imgui_bundle (interface)
notes: Includes ImGuiColorTextEdit and the Inconsolata font (SIL OFL 1.1).

name: CyDoc
notes: Bundled offline reader and image module. MIT notice: app/Documentation/DocData/CyDoc-LICENSE.txt. Pinned source package: app/.CyDocBuild/vendor/cydoc-source.json. Build tools are not reader runtime dependencies.

name: CyToolsCore 0.10.1
notes: Required SDK bundled in full Windows distributions from the pinned source wheel. Python sources and MIT notice are included; wheel provenance is in app/packaging/vendor/cytools-core-source.json.
